decisions.reason: The single-board decision does not establish that the charge-status indication or its connector is removed; the connector may still serve an external LED.
The battery interface remains necessary on the consolidated board, and the source decision does not change its connector, pinout, voltage range, or placement.
Consolidating the PCBs does not change the SPS30 requirement to hardwire SEL to ground for I2C operation.
The LED supply voltage, direct ESP32 logic drive, and separate LED power control remain valid independently of the removed interboard links.
The two electrical sources and OR-ing behavior may remain, but their state can no longer depend on a physically absent power board, and the source labels must reflect the integrated board.
